title: 第4章 临门一脚第3章 新年前夜
slug: 穿越成了游戏里的炮灰角色
content_zh:
法伦在办公室的沙发上醒来。
不远处的壁炉已经彻底熄灭，只余下几块焦炭尚散发着微弱的余温。
他微微侧过头，千代正蜷缩在他的身侧，昨晚他那件被弄得皱巴巴的白衬衫随意地盖在她的身上，而那件惊艳的墨绿晚礼裙则如同废弃的战甲般，孤零零地搭在沙发的扶手上。
衣衫褴褛足以看出昨晚战况的激烈。
法伦单手撑住身旁的实心橡木扶手准备起身，但在动作做到一半时，他硬生生停住了。
不对劲。
他起身的爆发速度，比他大脑预判的快了整整一倍，而这种事，在灵力如此强的现在，是不应该发生的事情才对。
“咔嚓——”
一声细微的脆响在安静的室内荡开。
法伦低头看去，只见自己掌心按压的那块坚硬橡木扶手上，竟被他无意间摁出了一圈蛛网般的深邃裂纹。
没有魔力波动的闪烁，也没有灵界光芒的加持。
这纯粹是肉体力量失控暴涨的结果。
对的，力量失控了。
他想起昨晚在最深沉的迷离中，千代贴在他耳边呢喃的话语：“力量……在流过去。”
那不仅仅是魔力的流淌。
高阶鬼族血脉的“反哺”，竟以蛮横的方式，硬生生将他原本就已经淬炼得坚韧的基础肉体强度，再次拔高了一个台阶。
身旁的呼吸声有了节奏的细微变化，千代睁开了眼。
晨光透过落地窗洒在她的脸上，那双原本暗红色的眼眸，此刻泛着比昨晚更深邃、更稳定的深紫色。
那是属于她本体状态下的自然光泽，清澈如同上好的紫水晶，再无半点被深渊与鬼化侵蚀的浑浊。
法伦指了指那块开裂的沙发扶手，平静地陈述了这个事实。

千代没有说话，只是从衬衫下伸出雪白的手臂，指尖捏了捏法伦的小臂肌肉。
法伦能清晰地感觉到，她那看似柔弱的指尖下，压抑着一股如渊渟岳峙般的恐怖力量。
“你变强了。”法伦看着她的眼睛说。
“你变硬了。”千代毫不避讳他的目光，轻声回应。
两人对视了片刻，法伦嘴角勾起一抹弧度，伸手握住她的手腕，将她从一片狼藉的沙发上拉了起来。
“我想确认一下。”
在走进单间连带的浴室前，只盖着一件衬衫的千代主动停下脚步，紫色的眼眸盯着法伦的后背。
她想验证昨晚的“反哺”究竟是偶然的激荡，还是某种稳定双修契约的形成。
法伦站在浴室宽大的镜子前，看着镜中倒映的自己，昨晚在情欲边缘时，后背被千代无意识抓出的几道深可见骨的血痕，此时只留下淡淡的白印。
千代伸手按在他宽阔的肩胛骨上，闭上眼，仔细感受着两人体内气机的交汇：“还在流……但已经趋于平缓了。”
“那要再试试嘛？”法伦眉头轻挑。
千代轻笑道：“只是为了力量嘛？”
“你觉得呢？”
法伦一把抱住千代的长腿，抵到了镜子前，柔软的嘴唇以最热烈的形式交织在一起。
窗外的积雪越下越厚，浴室内的温度却在逐渐升高。
在接下来的时间里，他们以最原始也最直接的方式，反复确认了彼此力量的“阈值”。
最终得知，法伦的肉体强化已经达到了当前境界的瓶颈，而千代体内那股随时会暴走的鬼化力量，也彻底停止了危险的溢出。
两人在这场互补中，达到了完美的动态平衡。
水声渐歇，两人陷入了短暂的沉默。
content_en:
Fallon wakes up on the couch in his office.
The fireplace not far away has been completely extinguished, leaving only a few pieces of coke still emitting a faint residual warmth.
He turned his head slightly, and Chiyo was curled up beside him. His wrinkled white shirt from last night was casually covering her body, and the stunning dark green evening dress was lying on the armrest of the sofa like an abandoned battle armor.
The ragged clothes were enough to show the intensity of the battle last night.
Fallon supported the solid oak handrail beside him with one hand and prepared to stand up, but in the middle of the movement, he stopped abruptly.
Something is wrong.
The explosive speed of his getting up was exactly twice as fast as his brain predicted, and this kind of thing shouldn't happen now that his spiritual power is so strong.
"Click——"
A subtle crisp sound resounded in the quiet room.
Fallon looked down and saw that the hard oak armrest he pressed with his palm had accidentally created a circle of deep cracks like a spider web.
There is no flicker of magic power, nor the blessing of light from the spiritual world.
This is purely the result of an out-of-control surge in physical strength.
Yes, the power is out of control.
He remembered the words Chiyo whispered in his ear last night when he was in the deepest confusion: "Power... is flowing through."
It wasn't just a flow of magic.
The "feedback" of the high-level ghost bloodline, in a brutal way, forcibly raised his already tough basic physical strength to a higher level.
The breathing next to her changed slightly in rhythm, and Chiyo opened her eyes.
The morning light shone on her face through the floor-to-ceiling windows, and her originally dark red eyes now glowed a deeper and more stable deep purple than last night.
It was the natural luster of her original state, as clear as a fine amethyst, without any turbidity eroded by the abyss and ghost transformation.
Fallon pointed to the cracked armrest of the sofa and stated the fact calmly.
Chiyo said nothing, but stretched out his white arms from under his shirt, and pinched Fallon's forearm muscles with his fingertips.
Fallon could clearly feel that under her seemingly weak fingertips, there was a terrifying power like a Yuan Ting Yue Zhi suppressed.
"You've gotten stronger," Fallon said, looking into her eyes.
"You've gotten hard." Chiyo responded softly without avoiding his gaze.
The two looked at each other for a moment, then Fallon's mouth curved, he reached out to hold her wrist and pulled her up from the messy sofa.
"I want to make sure."
Before walking into the single bathroom, Chiyo, who was only covered with a shirt, took the initiative to stop and stared at Fallon's back with her purple eyes.
She wanted to verify whether the "feedback" last night was an accidental agitation or the formation of some kind of stable double cultivation contract.
Fallon stood in front of the large mirror in the bathroom, looking at himself reflected in the mirror. When he was on the verge of lust last night, Chiyo unconsciously scratched his back with several bone-deep blood marks, leaving only a faint white mark.
Chiyo put her hand on his broad shoulder blades, closed her eyes, and carefully felt the intersection of Qi in the two people's bodies: "It's still flowing... but it has leveled off."
"Then you want to try again?" Fallon raised his eyebrows slightly.
Chiyo chuckled and said, "Is it just for the power?"
"What do you think?"
Fallon hugged Chiyo's long legs and leaned in front of the mirror, their soft lips intertwined in the most passionate way.
The snow outside the window is getting thicker and thicker, but the temperature in the bathroom is gradually rising.
In the following time, they repeatedly confirmed the "threshold" of each other's power in the most primitive and direct way.
In the end, it was learned that Fallon's physical enhancement had reached the bottleneck of the current state, and the demonic power in Chiyo's body that could go berserk at any time had completely stopped dangerously overflowing.
In this complementation, the two reached a perfect dynamic balance.
The sound of water gradually subsided, and the two fell into a brief silence.。
